correctness.rationale: Reconstructed q-overlap normalization, phase/unitary symmetry, and the rank-(n-1) isometric initial space of J_n. Equality in norm forces first coordinate zero, reducing the plateau exactly to the circular numerical range W(J_{n-1}) of radius cos(pi/n). For t>0, the top eigenvector of the irreducible positive-offdiagonal tridiagonal (J+tI)^*(J+tI) is simple and positive; paired left singular vector has real overlap s_n'(t), attaining the dual norm bound at the matching q. A common norming pair at two distinct t would force nilpotent J to have eigenvalue s(t)-t>0, so s strictly convex. Schur complement on e1 versus e2..en, followed by simple eigenvalue perturbation of J_{n-1}+J_{n-1}*, gives s(t)=1+q_n t+[(n+2)/(2n)]sin^2(pi/n)t^2+O(t^3); Legendre minimization gives the claimed coefficient. Checked q=1 separately and numerical SVD/minimizations n=4..8 for small delta, observed ratios tending to exact coefficients. Tests do not prove arbitrary n.
residual_risks: Finite SVD tests n=4..8 do not replace the all-n perturbation argument.
